## Design intent & interactions (manual)

- **Hero:** decorative SVG `linearGradient #grad` (navy→blue) on a rounded rect; four absolutely-positioned `.shape-*` blobs with float keyframes.
- **Products:** single-open accordion — each `.product-card`'s "Meet the specialist" toggle reveals its inline `#tab-inside/#tab-work/#tab-personal` panel.
- **Core-v2:** SVG masks/glow (`#output-logo-mask`, `cv-glow-*` gradients) with animated stroke paths (`cv-path-green/blue`); `requestAnimationFrame` driven.
- Gradient-text headings via `background-clip:text`. Scroll-reveal via one `IntersectionObserver`. ~36 keyframes total.
